question: Among healthcare providers whose practice location is in Mountain View, CA, and who have a specified specialization in the field healthcare provider taxonomy, identify the top 10 most common specializations based on the count of distinct NPIs. Then determine which of those top 10 has a count of distinct NPIs closest to the average count across those 10 specializations.

WITH mv_providers AS (
  SELECT npi, 
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14,
    healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nppes.npi_optimized`
  WHERE LOWER(provider_business_practice_location_address_city_name) = 'mountain view'
    AND provider_business_practice_location_address_state_name = 'CA'
),
unpivoted AS (
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_1 as tax_code FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_2 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_3 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_4 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_5 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_6 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_7 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_8 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_9 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_10 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_11 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_12 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_13 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_14 FROM mv_providers UNION ALL
  SELECT npi, healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_15 FROM mv_providers
),
with_specialization AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.npi, t.specialization
  FROM unpivoted u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nppes.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_set` t
    ON u.tax_code = t.code
  WHERE t.specialization IS NOT NULL AND t.specialization != ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT npi) as distinct_npi_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT npi) DESC) as rn
  FROM with_specialization
  GROUP BY specialization
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT specialization, distinct_npi_count
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 10
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) as avg_count FROM top10
)
SELECT t.specialization, t.distinct_npi_count, a.avg_count,
  ABS(t.distinct_npi_count - a.avg_count) as diff_from_avg
FROM top10 t, avg_calc a
ORDER BY diff_from_avg ASC
LIMIT 1
